local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local pCulture = Players[me]:GetCulture()
local row = GameInfo.Governments["GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY"]
if row == nil then print("ERR:GOV_NOT_FOUND|GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY"); print("---END---"); return end
if not pCulture:IsGovernmentUnlocked(row.Index) then print("ERR:GOV_LOCKED|GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY is not unlocked"); print("---END---"); return end
if row.Index == pCulture:GetCurrentGovernment() then print("ERR:ALREADY_CURRENT|GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY is already your government"); print("---END---"); return end
pCulture:SetGovernmentChangeConsidered(true)
pCulture:RequestChangeGovernment(row.Index)
print("OK:GOVERNMENT_CHANGED|GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY|" .. Locale.Lookup(row.Name))
print("---END---")
